scientific_limitations: The graph family consists only of ordinary consecutive-jump cycle powers; arbitrary circulants and graphs are not classified.
The infinite proof uses degree equality, complete triangle counts, and a modular multiplication isomorphism; finite verifier output is supporting evidence only.
Full texts of certain historical graph-equation papers and of the motivating 2026 preprint were not obtainable for complete comparison; an unindexed equivalent theorem is possible.
title: A triangle-defect classification of power–complementary cycle powers
